integer n, i, t, x, y, bin, done, fb(5)
double precision v(5), lo(5), hi(5)
read(5,*) n
lo(1) = 53.35d0
hi(1) = 1d30
fb(1) = 27
lo(2) = 347.67d0
hi(2) = 639.602d0
fb(2) = 21
lo(3) = 144.783d0
hi(3) = 1d30
fb(3) = 32
lo(4) = 203.585d0
hi(4) = 1d30
fb(4) = 24
lo(5) = -1d30
hi(5) = 394.729d0
fb(5) = 15
do i = 1, n {
  read(5,*) x, y, (v(t), t = 1, 5)
  bin = 1
  done = 0
  for (t = 1; t <= 5; t = t + 1) {
    if (done == 0) {
      if (v(t) == -9999d0) {
        bin = 34
        done = 1
      }
      else if (v(t) < lo(t) | v(t) > hi(t)) {
        bin = fb(t)
        done = 1
      }
    }
  }
  write(6,*) x, y, bin
}
end

integer n, i, j, x, y, bin, found
integer hasLo(3), hasHi(3), tbin(3)
double precision v(3), lo(3), hi(3)

# test 1: IDDQ, high limit 462.34, fail bin 33
hasLo(1) = 0
lo(1) = 0d0
hasHi(1) = 1
hi(1) = 462.34d0
tbin(1) = 33

# test 2: FMAX, low limit 168.168, fail bin 30
hasLo(2) = 1
lo(2) = 168.168d0
hasHi(2) = 0
hi(2) = 0d0
tbin(2) = 30

# test 3: VDD, limits 289.518 .. 432.282, fail bin 32
hasLo(3) = 1
lo(3) = 289.518d0
hasHi(3) = 1
hi(3) = 432.282d0
tbin(3) = 32

read(5,*) n
for (i = 1; i <= n; i = i + 1) {
  read(5,*) x, y, (v(j), j = 1, 3)
  bin = 1
  found = 0
  for (j = 1; j <= 3 & found == 0; j = j + 1) {
    if (v(j) == -9999d0) { bin = 26; found = 1 }
    else {
      if ((hasLo(j) == 1 & v(j) < lo(j)) | (hasHi(j) == 1 & v(j) > hi(j))) { bin = tbin(j); found = 1 }
    }
  }
  write(6,*) x, y, bin
}
end

integer n, i, k, x, y, bin, done, fb(3)
double precision v(3), lo(3), hi(3)

# test limits: -1d30 / 1d30 stand in for "no limit"
lo(1) = 402.262d0
hi(1) = 506.638d0
fb(1) = 32
lo(2) = -1d30
hi(2) = 112.409d0
fb(2) = 39
lo(3) = 177.423d0
hi(3) = 220.377d0
fb(3) = 6

read(5,*) n
do i = 1, n {
  read(5,*) x, y, (v(k), k = 1, 3)
  bin = 1
  done = 0
  k = 1
  while (k <= 3 & done == 0) {
    if (v(k) == -9999d0) {
      bin = 2
      done = 1
    }
    else if (v(k) < lo(k) | v(k) > hi(k)) {
      bin = fb(k)
      done = 1
    }
    k = k + 1
  }
  write(6,*) x, y, bin
}
end

integer n, i, x, y, b
double precision a, v, t
read(5,*) n
do i = 1, n {
  read(5,*) x, y, a, v, t
  b = 1
  if (a == -9999d0) b = 7
  else if (a < 27.403d0) b = 27
  else if (v == -9999d0) b = 7
  else if (v < 358.076d0) b = 32
  else if (t == -9999d0) b = 7
  else if (t < 103.093d0) b = 11
  write(6,*) x, y, b
}
end

integer n, i, t, bin, x, y, fb(4)
double precision v(4), lo(4), hi(4)
read(5,*) n
lo(1) = 26.415d0
hi(1) = 32.525d0
fb(1) = 6
lo(2) = -1d30
hi(2) = 241.017d0
fb(2) = 36
lo(3) = 27.595d0
hi(3) = 32.457d0
fb(3) = 8
lo(4) = -1d30
hi(4) = 406.023d0
fb(4) = 25
do i = 1, n {
  read(5,*) x, y, v(1), v(2), v(3), v(4)
  bin = 1
  t = 1
  while (t <= 4 & bin == 1) {
    if (v(t) == -9999d0) {
      bin = 39
    } else if (v(t) < lo(t) | v(t) > hi(t)) {
      bin = fb(t)
    }
    t = t + 1
  }
  write(6,*) x, y, bin
}
end

integer n, i, t, x, y, bin
integer fb(4)
double precision v(4), lo(4), hi(4)

read(5,*) n
lo(1) = 26.415d0
hi(1) = 32.525d0
fb(1) = 6
lo(2) = -1d30
hi(2) = 241.017d0
fb(2) = 36
lo(3) = 27.595d0
hi(3) = 32.457d0
fb(3) = 8
lo(4) = -1d30
hi(4) = 406.023d0
fb(4) = 25

do i = 1, n {
  read(5,*) x, y, v(1), v(2), v(3), v(4)
  bin = 1
  for (t = 1; t <= 4; t = t + 1) {

  write(6,*) x, y, bin
}
